regime_hint: steady state suppression with autonomous recovery

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in at least one of the two weeks following the PARKS collapse, or PARKS remains above 35 percentage points in t+0w.

If PARKS remains below 30 percentage points and RETAIL_REC does not improve by at least 2 percentage points per week, the substitution mechanism has failed.
